A PROMISE TO YOU

Your photos,
on your device.

Photos you take, images you import, and videos you decorate: Kikoo does not send or store your images, photos, or videos in the company's or its service providers' cloud. Capture and editing happen on your device.

Kikoo uses only the basic information needed to operate the service, such as account identifiers, purchase verification, coin balances and activity, basic usage statistics, and error information. Your chosen external sharing and iCloud Photos are governed by those services' policies.

See what information Kikoo uses ↗

A LITTLE HELP

A few quick answers.

Are my photos stored on Kikoo's servers?+

No. Kikoo does not send or store your photos and videos on its servers or in the cloud. Photos are not included in account sync, so save anything you want to keep directly to your photo library.

How do I buy coins and paid content?+

Coin packages and paid content shown in the app are purchased through Apple's in-app purchase system. You can review the price and what is included before purchase. Kikoo does not receive your card number or Apple Account password.

I bought coins, but they aren't showing up.+

Check that you are signed in to the Kikoo account linked to the purchase, then use the app's Check Purchases feature to review the transaction. If the issue continues, contact support before buying the same item again.
